messages:
Olivia Chen: Dropping a small iteration — Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/p95-heatmap-iter

Proposal summary:
- Stack p95 card + small throughput sparkline above the heatmap so users see the tail metric before diving into distribution.
- Move the sampling control into the timepicker row (left of presets) as a compact knob + label so it’s in the most discoverable spot for time‑scoped views.
- Add a compact toggle that collapses the throughput sparkline when vertical space is tight.
- Microcopy options: "Sampled view (approx.)" vs "Sampling: On (approx)" — leaning to first.

Feedback please, esp on focus order + keyboard affordances.

Sam Patel: Love the stacking idea — reduces scrolling. A few things:
- Can we show the effective sample rate in the tooltip (e.g. "sample rate ≈ 12%") so folks understand noisiness?
- Knob hit area should be >= 44px for touch.
- If the sampling control is in the time row, ensure it doesn't steal primary CTA space (Apply / Compare).

Also: :eyes: on how this behaves in narrow panes (sidebar open).

Arjun Gupta: Agree with Sam. Accessibility/keyboard notes:
- Add keyboard interactions: left/right arrow to nudge rate, page up/down for larger steps, Enter to apply.
- ARIA example for the knob:
```
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" aria-label="Sampling rate (percent)" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="10" />
```
- Please expose current rate in the DOM (text) so screen readers announce it, not just visually in tooltip.

Lina Morales: Microcopy + contrast nits:
- Prefer "Sampled view (approx.)" — shorter and clearer.
- Heatmap legend small labels fail AA contrast at 12px with current gray (#6b6b6b). Suggest #3f3f3f or at least #4a4a4a.
- Focus ring: use 3px high-contrast outline on the knob (not just box-shadow).

Kevin Ho: From infra perspective:
- If we do auto-sampling under heavy write/ingest, flag: p95 under tiny windows (<1s) can be misleading when sampled. Need an explicit badge: "sampled" + link to explain.
- Also log the sampling percent with the trace so we can correlate regressions.

design-bot: Checklist added to the ticket:
- [ ] Tooltip displays numeric sample rate
- [ ] Knob >=44px touch target
- [ ] Aria range + visible text for SR
- [ ] Heatmap legend contrast >= AA
- [ ] Focus order: time presets -> sampling -> calendar -> apply
- [ ] Small-screen layout: collapse sparkline by default
- Keyboard shortcut idea: press "S" to focus sampling control (needs product review)

Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4321

Olivia Chen: Updated the Figma with the contrast + aria text changes and an alternate overlay placement (knob in an overlay when the time row is crowded). Pinging @Sam Patel @Arjun Gupta for a quick playtest tomorrow at 10am PT. I'll add a short test script.

Playtest goals: verify discoverability, keyboard flow, and confirm sample-rate tooltip is clear.
Sam Patel: I'll run playtest and record notes.
Arjun Gupta: I'll check the SR logging hook with infra and flag any perf concerns.
Lina Morales: Small follow-up: microcopy in the help panel should be one sentence: "Sampled view shows a subset of requests; results are approximate." Keep it simple for non-technical PMs.
Kevin Ho: Noted. I'll add a quick server-side flag so we can toggle auto-sample behavior in staging.
Olivia Chen: Thanks all — we'll iterate after playtest. :sparkles:
